Research_Gap: Inference latency of quantum circuits makes real-time ranking impossible
Supporting_Papers: Graph Neural Networks on Quantum Computers (2024), Collaborative Filtering using VQHAM (2025)
Evidence: Authors evaluate on simulators without factoring in measurement shot counts (e.g. 1024 shots per forward pass).
Proposed_Solution: Offload quantum computation to offline embedding caching or use millisecond-latency Quantum Annealers.
Validation_Experiment: Measure end-to-end inference latency against classical 100ms SLAs.

Research_Gap: Testing on artificially dense toy datasets destroys the actual e-commerce problem
Supporting_Papers: Quantum Semi-Random Forests (2025), CRUISE on Quantum Computing (2024)
Evidence: Papers aggressively filter datasets to 5-10% density to fit into limited qubits.
Proposed_Solution: Use classical GNNs to handle 99.9% sparse data, reserving quantum for low-dim ranking.
Validation_Experiment: Evaluate on datasets with <0.1% density and cold-start cohorts.

Research_Gap: Unfair classical baselines masking 'decorative' quantum layers
Evidence: Hybrid models are compared against weak classical baselines without parameter-matched ablations.
Proposed_Solution: Strict ablation against classical Simulated Annealing and parameter-matched dense layers.
Validation_Experiment: Ablation: Remove quantum component and replace with classical equivalent; measure delta.

Research_Gap: Misuse of gate-based quantum for simple dot-products instead of combinatorial challenges
Supporting_Papers: Estimating Quantum Execution Requirements (2025), Performance-Driven QUBO (2024)
Evidence: Gate-based circuits are used for linear representation learning where GPUs excel.
Proposed_Solution: Shift quantum workload to diversity ranking (NP-Hard combinatorial QUBO).
Validation_Experiment: Candidate Scaling: Evaluate NDCG/Diversity as candidate size grows from 50 to 500.
